sources.entry: Movim - Modern, federated social network based on XMPP, with a fully featured group-chat, subscriptions and microblogging. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 PHP/Docker

summary.one_liner: Movim is a federated blogging and chat platform that serves as a web frontend for the XMPP protocol.
summary.what_it_does: Movim is a web-based social platform built on the XMPP protocol, combining federated blogging and chat in one interface. The README describes it as a web frontend for XMPP, and the awesome-selfhosted listing mentions group chat, subscriptions and microblogging. Deployment is documented in an INSTALL.md file and on the Movim Wiki. The README also describes a podman-compose setup that launches a local test instance with a blank database and a self-signed certificate. That setup is stated to be for testing only, with caches disabled and containers not optimized. A prebuilt container image is available at ghcr.io/movim/movim:latest, which requires PostgreSQL. The README points to SECURITY.md for security reports and to a Transifex project for translations.
use_cases: run a web client for XMPP chat
group chat on a self-hosted XMPP server
test a federated social platform locally in a container
how_to_run: Install podman-compose and clone the repository
Wait a few minutes for the local test instance to start
Open the URL shown in the README in a browser and accept the self-signed certificate
For a real deployment, follow the INSTALL.md instructions or the Movim Wiki
notable: Web frontend for the XMPP protocol, so it works as a federated social client
Combines blogging, microblogging, group chat and subscriptions in one platform
Ships a podman-compose test setup and a prebuilt container image
caveats: The podman-compose setup is for testing only; containers are not optimized and most caches are disabled
The container image requires a separate PostgreSQL database
